title.narrative: Technical Assistance to Facilitate and Coordinate the Humanitarian Response to the Syria Crisis

description.narrative: This activity Technical Assistance to Facilitate and Coordinate the Humanitarian Response to the Syria Crisis is a component of Syria Humanitarian Assistance, 2013 - 2016 reported by FCDO with a funding type of 105 - Humanitarian assistance and a budget of £1,000,000. This project benefits Middle East, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Relief co-ordination and support services.
